shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --stat | head -30; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node -v
cat src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/theme/; cat build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && sed -n 1,200p uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -nE "selected|href|view|extraProps|component" ; ls icons | grep -iE "^(Sun|Moon|House|Gear|Circle|ListUl|Info|TrashBin|Plus)[A-Za-z]*\.js$"; grep -n "items\|name\|children" uikit/build/esm/components/DefinitionList/types.d.ts | head; ls uikit/build/esm/components/controls; cat uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts | head -20

grep -A3 '"dependencies"\|peerDep' uikit/package.json | head; grep version icons/package.json; cat uikit/build/esm/components/DefinitionList/types.d.ts uikit/build/esm/components/DefinitionList/DefinitionList.d.ts; grep -n "Props\b\|export" uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' package-lock.json; grep -n -B2 -A6 '"node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons"' package-lock.json | head -20
npm pkg set 'dependencies.@gravity-ui/icons=^2.16.0' && npm install --offline --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3 && git diff --stat

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/main.tsx'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""// Preconfigured Gravity UI setup is ALREADY wired here (both CSS imports + ThemeProvider).
// Implement the requested feature in App.tsx (you may add sibling files).
""","""// Gravity UI styles are loaded here; the ThemeProvider lives in App so the theme can be switched at runtime.
""").replace("import { ThemeProvider } from '@gravity-ui/uikit';\n","").replace("""    <ThemeProvider theme="light">
      <App />
    </ThemeProvider>""","""    <App />""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/App.tsx'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("extraProps={{'aria-current': active ? 'page' : undefined}}","""extraProps={{
                                        'aria-current': active ? 'page' : undefined,
                                        'aria-label': item.title,
                                    }}""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='index.html'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('lang="en"','lang="ru"').replace('Gravity UI eval','Мини-приложение')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat src/main.tsx; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
sed -i 's/lang="en"/lang="ru"/; s/Gravity UI eval/Мини-приложение/' index.html && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -6
which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules | grep -iE "jsdom|happy|playwright|puppeteer"
sed -i "s/root: '..', //" .smoke/vite.config.mjs && npx vite build -c .smoke/vite.config.mjs --ssr .smoke/entry.tsx --outDir .smoke/out --emptyOutDir --logLevel error && node .smoke/run.mjs
sed -i 's/const miss = needles/html = html.replace(\/<!-- -->\/g, ""); const miss = needles/' .smoke/run.mjs && node .smoke/run.mjs 2>/dev/null
